p: they came over unto the other: Many hold the virtue of Christ in admiration, and yet they will not lose even the least thing they have in order to redeem it.
with an unclean spirit: Literally, "in an unclean spirit"; now they are said to be in the spirit because the spirit holds them tightly locked up, and as it were bound.
adjure thee by God: That is, assure me by an oath that you will not vex me.
besought him much that he would: The demon that was the spokesperson of the many.
mountains a great herd of swine: This whole country is for the most part very hilly, for the mountains of Galeed run through it.
sea: Strabo in the sixteenth book says that in Gadaris there is a standing pool of very polluted water, which if beasts taste, they shed their hair, nails, or hooves and horns.
behold: The whole company did not assemble without any structure, but in every synagogue there were certain men who governed the people.
And a certain woman: Jesus being touched with true faith, although it is but weak, heals us by his virtue.
As soon as Jesus heard the: By faith fathers apprehended the promises of life even for their children.
And they laughed him to scorn: Such as mock and scorn Christ are unworthy to be witnesses of his goodness.
that were with him: The three disciples.
